name: ML Algorithms devcontainer
updateContentCommand: mkdir -p /root/.ssh && cp -R /root/.ssh_mount/* /root/.ssh/ && rm -f /root/.ssh/githubkey /root/.ssh/githubkey.pub && chown -R root:root /root/.ssh && chmod 700 /root/.ssh && chmod 600 /root/.ssh/config /root/.ssh/id_* && chmod 644 /root/.ssh/*.pub /root/.ssh/known_hosts*
postCreateCommand: apt-get update && apt-get install -y git && uv sync
